text:
maya: Heads up — embargo window for launch v2 moving to Apr 8 09:00 PT. Need to lock analyst brief slots + quote approvals today.

leo: Can we split EU / US briefings? timezone conflict otherwise.

sam: Yes. proposed slots: Apr 8 08:00 PT (APAC-friendly), Apr 8 11:00 PT (EU/US).

frank: Who owns quote approval? Legal already flagged 'no forward-looking #' in drafts.

maya: Emily will own quotes + final factcheck. @emily can you confirm?

emily: I can. Will drop final quote by EOD and ping legal for one-line clearance. Need one more data point from eng: 95th perc latency numbers for r100 benchmark.

leo: I'll ask infra to run r100 regen now. ETA ~3h.

sam: Press list attached: https://drive.redwood/press/launch-v2 — please add any analysts we should prioritize.

maya: Important: prefer to brief these analyst types: infra/platform, cost ops, devtools.

frank: If capacity limited, prioritize Gartner + Forrester + Omdia.

press-bot: Reminder: embargo set to 2026-04-08T16:00Z as of 1796422080.

emily: Got it. Also requesting pre-approved quote variants: 2 short, 1 long. I'll paste templates: 
```
Short: "Redwood Inference makes inference predictable at scale with low-latency routing and cost controls."
Short alt: "We help engineering teams run models reliably while cutting per-token cost."
Long: "By combining a GPU-optimized runtime, smart routing, and caching, Redwood Inference reduces latency variance and makes cost predictable across hosted and private deployments."
```

maya: I'll own the analyst slide deck + demo walk. @sam can you prepare the benchmark section and 2 slides on routing policy?

sam: On it. Will include perf matrix and cost delta table. Quick Q — do we disclose quantization details in deck?

leo: Recommend mention "quantization optimizations" high-level, no op-level specifics.

emily: Legal clearance for quotes / datasheets: we'll need a stamp by engineering and product.

frank: If any analyst asks for raw logs or benchmarking scripts, we should route to Solutions — not public.

maya: :thumbsup: timeline: 12:00 PT final quote, 15:00 PT deck lock, 16:00 PT embargo publish.

press-bot: Slot booked: Apr 8 11:00 PT — 45m briefing with Forrester (reservation id 5521).

sam: Thanks. If infra misses numbers, fallback is to use previous r90 numbers with a note.

emily: I'll prepare quote variants and share in thread when ready.

leo: I'll update the invite calendar and cc press contacts.

maya: Perfect. Anything blocking? If not, let's run the checklist: quotes, deck, perf, legal.

frank: No blockers from my side.

emily: Sharing draft short quotes now — dropping into thread in 5.

press-bot: Noted. Live checklist updated: quotes (in progress), deck (in progress), perf (pending), legal (pending).

maya: Great work team — we'll reconvene if any of the items slip.
